news.body:
## You cleared three on Sunday
- The INSEAD CV rebuild, the post-MBA statement and the CareerGlobe profile all went in one evening.
That is the whole of what the career track was waiting on from you, and the CV in particular is what the applications below need in hand.

## The applications are the next real block of work
- Google Strategy and Operations in London, Google Business Analyst in Dublin and Amazon Launch in Luxembourg all close on 8 November.
Each is marked a full day, which puts the start of the last one at 3 November. You fly on the 4th, the KITAS expires on the 8th and the SBI documents are dated the 10th, so that week has no room in it. - Taking a day this week for the first two is the only version of that week that works.
